text.formatted: When you cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.
text.plain: When you cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

gaps.name: For this casting, change an action casting time to a Bonus Action for 2 Sorcery Points while preserving other costs.
